translation_notes: Binding restored (AGENT_BATCH's 163-regions case): the extracted region has an empty context and `model` carries no annotation, so the stratifier's static pass could not see it is an rdflib Graph (rdf_ops: 0, categories: {} above, hence meta.oracle defaulted to "isomorphism" even though the region only reads). Restored with `model: Graph` + `from rdflib import Graph`, identically in original.py and translated.ldpy; the function body is otherwise untouched.

Textbook trav_existence, and the cleanest possible instance: `model.value(subject, predicate, None) is not None` discards the value entirely -- only the None/not-None distinction is used, never the value itself -- so it is genuine existence, not the .first()-shaped reuse case INSTRUCTIONS_403's AVERTISSEMENT warns about. Translated `@graph model` + `return bool(m{ {subject} {predicate} ?o })`, per the stratum's own mapping (`g.value(...) is not None` -> `bool(m{ })`).

meta.json's `oracle` field is left as the pipeline computed it ("isomorphism") -- it is provenance from the tirage, not something this region's driver follows; the driver actually used is fixture+entry (values oracle), the same call made for the RDFLib__prez sibling of this stratum with the identical oracle/rdf_ops mismatch.

fixture.ttl / driver.py: `_has_property` takes three arguments (model, subject, predicate), so the default fixture= calling convention doesn't fit; calls= is explicit, one (subject, predicate) pair per case. Two solutions for ex:s1/ex:p1, one for ex:s1/ex:p2 (both True); zero solutions three ways -- a predicate never used on the subject (ex:s1/ex:p3), the predicate present but on a different subject (ex:s2/ex:p2), and a subject entirely absent from the graph (ex:s3/ex:p1) -- proving the read is scoped to the exact pair, not the subject or predicate alone.

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the redundant `None` object argument of `model.value(subject, predicate, None)` goes. `(subject, predicate, None) in model` would be one token shorter but is not equivalent when `predicate` is None (value() then returns None, the membership test is True for any triple of the subject), so it is not used.

optimized.ldpy: identical to optimized.py, no island. `bool(m{ {subject} {predicate} ?o }(model))` (or with `@graph model`) measures 4 tokens more than the Python line it replaces, so the Python is kept (AGENT_OPTIMIZE rule 4).
No exception to the symmetry rule. The region is a one-line existence test that rdflib already writes compactly: the notation brings nothing here.
header_optimization_notes: Nothing unused: the only header import, `from rdflib import Graph`, is the annotation of `model`. The header-variant files are copies of the optimized ones.
